mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use OpenSSL as the TLS implementation, chosen for its maturity, reliability, and proven production track record, in keeping with a preference for battle-tested libraries for critical cryptographic operations. No later decision superseding this has been recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
